parameters.content:
## BOMBO || بومبو  daily Shorts agent (n8n Cloud)
Gemini writes an episode (Egyptian Arabic, per-character lines) > JSON2Video draws every scene with AI (semi-realistic 3D cats in luxury interiors), voices each character with Azure Arabic voices, burns Arabic captions > YouTube upload > Telegram report.

**Edit in Config:** characters (looks + voices), stylePrompt, themes, outro line, privacy, madeForKids.
**Test first:** privacy = private, click Execute workflow, check the video in YouTube Studio, then Activate.
**Set Error Workflow:** Workflow settings > Error workflow > this workflow.

assignments.name: stylePrompt
assignments.value: Ultra-detailed semi-realistic 3D animation, Pixar quality, cats with realistic soft fur and expressive human-like faces acting like people, elegant human clothing, cinematic soft lighting, luxurious photorealistic interior, shallow depth of field, rich warm colors

assignments.name: charactersJson
assignments.value: [{"name": "Bombo", "voice": "ar-EG-ShakirNeural", "look": "Bombo, a sleek black British shorthair cat with glossy black fur and round yellow-green eyes, standing upright like a person, wearing a black tuxedo with a white shirt, a black bow tie and a white pocket square", "trait": "confident, dramatic, secretly clumsy, big-hearted butler-like gentleman"}, {"name": "Lolo", "voice": "ar-EG-SalmaNeural", "look": "Lolo, an elegant white Siamese-style cat princess with cream-white fur, a soft gray face mask, bright blue eyes, standing upright like a person, wearing a golden jeweled tiara, a pearl necklace and a green brocade Victorian gown with gold embroidery", "trait": "smart, kind, brave, a little sassy"}, {"name": "Pinky", "voice": "ar-AE-FatimaNeural", "look": "Pinky, a fluffy gray British longhair cat with round yellow-green eyes, standing upright like a person, wearing a pink lace shawl, a pearl necklace and a light-blue lace dress", "trait": "sweet, curious, gossipy, always hungry"}, {"name": "Boss", "voice": "ar-SA-HamedNeural", "look": "Boss, a big dark-brown cat with black-rimmed glasses and green eyes, standing upright like a person, wearing a black suit and a black shirt", "trait": "strict, loud, short-tempered but secretly fair; use only in office or authority stories"}, {"name": "Ginger", "voice": "ar-AE-HamdanNeural", "look": "Ginger, a young orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a fluffy white chest, standing upright like a person", "trait": "anxious, funny, always in trouble, lovable; use only in office or mishap stories"}, {"name": "Narrator", "voice": "ar-SA-ZariyahNeural", "look": "", "trait": "warm storyteller, used rarely"}]

assignments.name: themes
assignments.value: an elegant afternoon tea party where gossip causes a funny misunderstanding|a behind-the-scenes photo shoot on a theatre stage that goes hilariously wrong|the strict Boss scolds Ginger for a mistake, then everyone discovers it was not his fault|Bombo tries to impress Lolo with a fancy dinner but everything goes wrong|a missing royal jewel and a funny culprit in the Victorian salon|Pinky spreads a rumor and the friends must fix it before the grand party|a surprise birthday party for Lolo that almost gets ruined|Bombo is afraid of something silly and learns courage|a piano concert where the music keeps getting interrupted|a luxury penthouse mix-up: the wrong guest, the wrong gift, a very funny night|friends compete in a cooking contest in the grand kitchen|a mysterious letter arrives at the castle and sends the friends on an adventure

assignments.name: outroLine
assignments.value: لو عجبتكم الحكاية، اشتركوا في قناة بومبو وفعّلوا الجرس عشان تشوفوا مغامرة جديدة كل يوم!

assignments.name: descFooter
assignments.value:
🐱 اشتركوا في قناة BOMBO || بومبو لمتابعة مغامرات بومبو ولولو كل يوم!
#بومبو #BOMBO #قطط #كرتون #Shorts
